checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan Tessera: pure seamless-pattern engine, static browser studio, SVG export, tests, and an embed contract for the AegeanWorks site

impact_assessment.why: The user wants a new static showcase project for the website, like Prism-Relay but not necessarily a game; a zero-dependency pattern studio is instantly visible, interactive and useful without a backend.
impact_assessment.benefits: A polished, offline-capable browser demo with deterministic pattern generation, crisp SVG export, accessible controls, and a commit-versioned build the website can embed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new standalone project plus a website-ready static layout; dependency: none beyond Node 20 for tests and tooling; concurrency: the AegeanWorks playable-weft work is uncommitted and must not be overwritten; state: localStorage preferences and URL parameters.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Build and test the pure engine first, keep runtime files under index.html and src/**, avoid touching the website repo while its playable task is uncommitted, and run the project gates before delivery.

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Tessera implemented and verified: pure motif/palette/seed engine, SVG serializer, accessible static studio, export/copy, presets, URL + localStorage state, local server, brand assets, README, ADRs and 74 Node tests. checklists: passed

handoff.state: all runtime and docs files are uncommitted in projects/tessera
handoff.next: authorize a commit on master, then run python aikit.py check --strict tessera before committing
handoff.open: the AegeanWorks Play catalog validates AGL-1.1 game builds only and Tessera is AL-1.1, so site wiring needs an AL-1.1 demo lane
handoff.evidence: npm test 74/74, aikit check 4/4, site validate_source returns only 'Tessera LICENSE is not the AGL-1.1 text', CDP run exercised motif/palette/ranges/seed/preset/randomize/guides/motion/keyboard/storage and parsed the exported SVG.

checkpoints.description: [5/5] Final verification: 74/74 Node tests, 4/4 project gates, static embed contract OK, 108 motif/palette/seed SVGs parsed in-browser with zero console errors, no overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920. checklists: passed

handoff.state: all project files remain uncommitted on master
handoff.next: commit only after explicit user authorization
